As the 2026 World Cup approaches its conclusion, Major League Soccer (MLS) will make its return on Apple TV tomorrow, with Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+ and other platforms also rolling out a range of related features simultaneously. Details are as follows.

MLS makes a strong comeback on Apple TV

Apple today is specially promoting the return of its Apple League Soccer coverage, with six matches set to take place over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced it will roll out a range of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode features German football legend Thomas Müller as guest, "reflecting on the hard work he put in before his career took off, and sharing how he embraces the challenges of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also launch a number of exclusive playlists curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, along with themed playlists from a host of Eastern and Western Conference clubs such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple will launch "matchday guides produced by MLS clubs, as well as city tours personally recommended by players, helping fans discover great places to watch the game, local restaurants, must-visit hotspots and detailed stadium information."

As for users of the Apple Sports app, they can stay up to date with the latest league developments, including live scores, standings, match play-by-play, formations and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available at no additional cost to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide, and Apple will provide exclusive content and access to tournaments and playoffs throughout the season.

For more information on Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please click this link.

Apple TV is available for US$12.99 per month, or via an Apple One bundle subscription. The platform offers a range of hit series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
